description.description: A biblical illustration depicting the sacrifice of a Red Heifer on a wooden altar. A central figure in priestly white robes and a turban performs the ritual with a knife, while another priest holds a torch and a third holds hyssop and cedar wood. A crowd of people stands in the background before a large structure resembling a temple. The style is a sepia-toned sketch with selective highlights of color on the heifer and the priests' garments.
